key_insight: QuantiSpect replaces dense 3D convolutions with factorized spatial, temporal, and spatio-temporal branches to make surface-code pre-decoding much lighter without losing decoding quality.
engineering_relevance: The design reduces parameters and compute enough to improve real-time quantum error correction scalability, which is critical for low-latency fault-tolerant hardware control.
method: Depthwise spatial branch for syndrome-local patterns
Depthwise temporal branch for time-correlated errors
evidence_signal: On a 4×A100 benchmark, QuantiSpect matched the Accurate baseline’s receptive field at R=13 while using 0.663M vs 1.80M parameters and ~2.84× fewer per-voxel MACs, with threshold and accuracy parity at moderate/large distances.
watch_item: Performance gains depend on architecture-specific factorization and benchmark conditions, so hardware integration and decoding latency must still be validated in full system settings.
paper_title: QuantiSpect: A Structure-Aware Lightweight 3D CNN Pre-Decoder for Scalable Surface Code Quantum Error Correction
